e1_pgct_s1.policy: stochastic masked; independent local NumPy RNG per episode
e1_pgct_s1.target: Finite-horizon discounted empirical return, zero tail at step 500
e1_pgct_s1.early_prefix: First 200 steps of 500-step episodes, >=300 remaining steps; continuing tail bias attenuated, not removed
e1_pgct_s1.td: One-step absolute TD error; bootstrap on truncation, zero on termination
e1_pgct_s1.limitation: Each model visits its own states. This does not isolate critic quality on a shared on-policy state distribution; 10 evaluation episodes and one training seed are exploratory.
